purpose: Teach: 今や/いったん/実物/新品/ため息/吹く/丸い/酷い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、今や、絶対、人気店、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、嬉しいよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm so glad this place is already getting popular. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warmth rising on each clause. Genuine praise without performance. Soft eye contact. The tempo of someone sharing something they've been holding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、いったん、絶対、休憩、絶対、入れるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And I'm actually building in a proper break schedule this time. I'm serious about that.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded. A small nod to herself on 'this time.' Practical efficiency in the cadence. Not defensive, just — stating what's real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お皿、絶対、実物、絶対、見せてくれる?メイちゃん
lines.en: Will you show me the plates you picked? The actual ones?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, leaning slightly forward. A question asked from real interest, not obligation. Soft lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、新品、絶対、の、絶対、コーヒーマシン、絶対、入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We actually installed a brand-new espresso machine just last week. I'm really proud of it.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Pride without boasting. Light energy on 'brand-new.' The cadence of someone sharing something concrete they've worked for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ため息、絶対、つかないでね、メイちゃん、絶対、心配するわ
lines.en: Don't sigh about it, okay? I know you worry, but I'm taking care of things this time.
lines.style: Tender underneath. Reading her concern accurately. Steady reassurance. A small protective edge — not irritation, gentleness with teeth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、ドアから、絶対、風が、絶対、吹く、絶対、と、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、お知らせよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The storefront actually gets this beautiful light in the afternoons. Wind comes through the door and the whole place just glows.
lines.style: Quiet delight. Painting the image as she speaks. Slower pace on the description. The rhythm of noticing something small and beautiful about her own space.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、丸い、絶対、お皿、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: I love the round plates you chose. They feel right for the space.
lines.style: Affirming, specific praise. Resting on the detail of 'round.' Not effusive — just genuine recognition of what works.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、酷い、絶対、対応、絶対、絶対しないよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I promise I won't treat customers poorly this time. That's non-negotiable for me.
lines.style: Sincere, grounded. A real commitment stated quietly. No defensiveness, just — this matters. Steady eye contact through the end.
